mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the year-over-year change of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates disinflationary pressure, reducing real interest rate expectations and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of months with declining year-over-year CPIAUCSL change, or the Rank IC for the CPIAUCSL trend signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of months with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for the FEDFUNDS threshold signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and declining labor market slack (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicates a tightening monetary policy amid a strong labor market, increasing recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening cycle with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high housing starts (HOUST > 1400.0), consumer demand peaks and equity valuations become stretched, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion by the regime_hint, or the Rank IC for the HOUST signal in late-cycle is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of months with rising PAYEMS, or the Rank IC for the PAYEMS trend signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.0%, it signals an overheating labor market that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of months with UNRATE < 3.0%, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE threshold signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity that drives corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO are rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply chain recovery regime characterized by rising industrial production (INDPRO > 102.0), corporate margins improve as bottlenecks ease, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods classified as supply chain recovery by the regime_hint, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO signal in supply chain recovery is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
